## Assignment Simulated Data

### 1. Simulation code

```{r}

olink_inflammation_cytokines_1000 = read.csv("olink_inflammation_cytokines_1000.csv", check.names = FALSE)

set.seed(1)
n = 30      # Sample size
ng = 2      # Number of groups
p = 1000    # Number of variables 
groups=c(rep("A",n),rep("B",n))   # TRUE groups: A = healthy, B = disease
groupB=(n+1):(n*ng)                # Columns belonging to the disease group
r = rnorm(n*ng*p, mean = 4, sd =2)

# Putting data into a matrix
data = matrix(r, p, n*ng)
data

# Add column and row names to df
colnames(data) = c(paste("HD", 1:n, sep=""), paste("Disease", 1:n, sep=""))
rownames(data) = c(paste(olink_inflammation_cytokines_1000$Assay, 1:p, sep=""))
data
```
